maya_cs: Heads up — Oakwell Health pilot goes live in eu-west-1 next Tue 09:00 UTC. They need a temporary QPS increase and an allowlist so their partner proxy can hit the edge. Also want model pinned to redwood-med-3-eu variant for consistent latency. Renewal risk: they're on trial credits and will decide after the pilot. Can ops + sales coordinate? :calendar:
liam_se: Got it. Can you paste the partner IPs and target QPS? Also any expected burst pattern (sustained vs demo spike)?
maya_cs: IPs: `34.122.10.5`, `34.122.10.6`, `34.122.10.7`. Target baseline QPS 120 -> bump to 400 for pilot window (3 hours), then back to 120. Burst tolerance: occasional short spikes to 600 for ~30s. No persistent KV cache sharing across regions.
nora_ops: @maya_cs thanks. We'll need a provisioning ticket for the allowlist + soft quota change, and a model pin in routing policy. Can you confirm customer org id and contact for compliance sign-off?
maya_cs: Org: oakwell-health-prod (org_0942). Contact: emma@oakwell.co (engineering lead). Compliance OK with partner proxy IPs, they sent an approved list. I'll open the support ticket now.
maya_cs: Creating ticket with necessary details — will include test call samples and expected timestamps. cc @nora_ops @liam_se
devops-bot: Ticket created: PROV-4872 — "Oakwell: eu-west-1 allowlist + temporary QPS bump". Assigned to nora_ops. ETA initial config 4h.
liam_se: Thanks. Can SRE confirm if pinning to redwood-med-3-eu is possible with current capacity? Any fallback model plan if that variant becomes unavailable?
nora_ops: Checking capacity — redwood-med-3-eu has room for a short reserved burst. I'll add an automatic fallback to redwood-med-2-eu (slightly higher latency) in the rollout policy. Will include canary: 10% then 100% after 15m if no errors.
sam_account: FYI — flagged renewal watch. I'll schedule a touchpoint with Oakwell for the day after pilot and prep a usage summary + cost estimate if they scale. Need product + engineering to prepare perf numbers.
maya_cs: Perfect. Customer wants a 30-min enablement session Tue 08:15 UTC to validate integration before go. Can someone from eng be on call for latency checks and KV/WS handshakes?
oliver_sales: I'll join the enablement call. @liam_se can you provide a one-pager on expected latency & cost delta for the temp bump to share with Oakwell prior to the session?
liam_se: Yep. I'll drop a short doc in the ticket and share in channel. Rough numbers: baseline 120 qps -> p50 ~85ms p95 ~180ms. With burst config and pin -> p50 ~70ms p95 ~160ms but cost up ~2.8x during burst window. Exact will be in doc.
maya_cs: Added test curl snippet to the ticket:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" \
  -H "X-Org-Id: org_0942" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-med-3-eu","input":"health-check"}'
```
nora_ops: Provisioning note: I'll set the allowlist at the edge and create a temp rate-window rule: `quota:400` with `burst:600` for `03:00:00` duration, auto-revoke at `2025-06-30T09:00:00Z` (will extend if needed). Also pin config + fallback added. Rolling out in staging now.
devops-bot: Provisioning completed in staging — PROV-4872-STG passed smoke tests. Ready for production rollout after manual approval.
maya_cs: Approving production roll once ops confirms edge egress and that canary routing is live. @nora_ops pls advise when ready.
nora_ops: Canary routing live 1756004360. Edge allowlist applied 1756004362. Production soft quota updated 1756004365. Monitoring hooks (latency & error-rate) added to dashboard `oakwell-pilot`.
sam_account: Great — scheduled renewal check for 2025-07-07, will prep materials. Also capturing customer feedback in CRM: pilot objective = validate latency and cost tradeoffs for scaling partner integrations.
oliver_sales: I'll send Oakwell a short pre-call email with the enablement agenda and the one-pager. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
maya_cs: Thanks team. I'll run the enablement at 08:15 UTC and post notes after. Closing loop here.
